backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko actor with no functional logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features, related files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collection of short summaries describing various frontend utilities, components, and state stores.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_TROUBLESHOOTING.md: Guide outlining steps to diagnose and resolve deployment failures, including logs, common issues, and quick fixes.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining base styles and light/dark theme CSS variables.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry with metadata, root mount point, scripts, and favicon link tags.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component handling authentication, prompt filtering/sorting, view modes, dialogs, and logout flow.
frontend/src/components/auth/SignInScree: Sign‑in screen component prompting users to authenticate via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/categories/Categ: UI bar for filtering prompts by favorites or category using badges and buttons.
Category selection component allowing creation and toggling of categories with checkboxes.
frontend/src/components/categories/Manag: Dialog component for renaming and deleting categories, including updating and removing them from prompts with confirmation handling.
frontend/src/components/importExport/Imp: Provides UI controls for exporting prompts to JSON and importing prompts from a file, updating prompt and category stores.
frontend/src/components/prompts/ConfirmD: Reusable confirmation dialog with customizable title, description, and confirm action.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptAc: Renders action buttons for a prompt including copy, favorite, duplicate, edit, and delete operations.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptCo: Displays sanitized HTML content for a prompt using dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptEd: Dialog for creating or editing a prompt with title, rich text content, categories, and favorite status.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptGr: Grid layout for displaying prompts with previews, categories, and action controls.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptLi: List-style view showing full prompt content with categories and action buttons.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptPr: Dialog for viewing a prompt’s full sanitized content in a scrollable layout.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptTa: Table layout for prompts with sortable fields and row click preview, including embedded action controls.
frontend/src/components/search/SearchInp: Search input component with icon that forwards text changes.
frontend/src/components/sorting/SortDrop: Dropdown for selecting prompt sort mode using the app’s SortMode enum.
frontend/src/components/views/ViewModeTo: Toggle buttons for switching between list, grid, and table view modes.
frontend/src/features/auth/iiProviderLog: Utilities for validating II provider URLs and performing full-page Internet Identity logout flows.
frontend/src/features/auth/logoutReturnU: Generates the fixed post-logout return URL containing the required admin token hash.
frontend/src/features/auth/useReliableII: React hook coordinating local auth clearing and full II provider logout with redirect.
frontend/src/features/categories/categor: Zustand store managing category list with add, rename, delete, and set operations.
frontend/src/features/clipboard/useCopyT: Hook providing clipboard copy functionality with fallback and copied-state flag.
frontend/src/features/importExport/expor: Exports prompts and categories to a downloadable JSON file with metadata.
frontend/src/features/importExport/impor: Imports prompts JSON, validates structure, fixes ID collisions, and returns parsed data.
frontend/src/features/importExport/schem: Defines export data shape and validates imported data against expected prompt fields.
Filters prompts by favorites, category, and case-insensitive text search.
frontend/src/features/prompts/id.ts: Generates unique prompt IDs using timestamp and random suffix.
frontend/src/features/prompts/promptStor: Zustand store for adding, updating, deleting, duplicating, and managing prompt favorites and categories.
frontend/src/features/prompts/sorting.ts: Sorts prompts by date, title, edit time, or favorite status based on selected sort mode.
frontend/src/features/prompts/types.ts: Type definitions for Prompt objects plus ViewMode and SortMode enums.
frontend/src/features/richText/htmlToPla: Strips HTML tags and decodes entities to return collapsed plain text.
frontend/src/features/richText/sanitizeH: Cleans HTML by allowing only basic formatting tags and safe span styles.
frontend/src/features/richText/SimpleRic: ContentEditable rich text editor with bold, italic, and color formatting controls.
frontend/src/features/storage/localStora: Loads and saves prompts, categories, and view mode to localStorage.
frontend/src/features/storage/useAutoPer: Syncs prompt and category state with localStorage on load and updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and refreshes a backend actor based on Internet Identity and invalidates dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides authentication state and helpers using Internet Identity via React context.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/lib/favicon.ts: Deprecated no-op placeholder for old favicon handling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with query client and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme extensions, colors, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Holds project metadata, requirements, features, and favicon-related tasks.
